dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 11, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Tigers Top Guardians in Thrilling 6-4 Victory**

The Detroit Tigers pulled off a dramatic comeback win over the Cleveland Guardians, taking the final score 6-4. Chase DeLauter led the charge with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, including a crucial RBI. Meanwhile, Drew Anderson shone on the mound, striking out 4 in 4 innings. Jacob Waguespack earned the win, while Kenley Jansen closed out the game with a save. 

**Marlins Shut Down Pirates 2-0**

In a low-scoring contest, the Miami Marlins dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, taking the final score 2-0. Esteury Ruiz provided the offense with a 1-hit, 1-home run performance, including an RBI. Eury Pérez was nearly unhittable on the mound, striking out 7 in 7 innings. His dominant performance earned him the win.

**Cubs Outlast Nationals 8-6**

The Chicago Cubs overcame a late surge by the Washington Nationals to take the final score 8-6. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the win and the save in a relief appearance.

**Yankees Blank Mariners 4-1**

The New York Yankees cruised to a 4-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners. Randy Arozarena delivered a 1-hit, 1-home run performance, including an RBI. Bryan Woo shone on the mound, striking out 5 in 5 innings.

**Blue Jays Outlast Red Sox 5-3**

The Toronto Blue Jays edged out the Boston Red Sox, taking the final score 5-3. Ceddanne Rafaela led the Blue Jays' offense with a 1-hit, 1-home run performance, including 2 RBIs. Dylan Cease was solid on the mound, striking out 7 in 5 innings.

**Braves Shut Down Mets 4-0**

The Atlanta Braves dominated the New York Mets, taking the final score 4-0. Matt Olson delivered a 1-hit, 1-home run performance, including 2 RBIs. Martín Pérez was nearly unhittable on the mound, striking out 2 in 6 innings.

**Orioles Take Down Twins 5-2**

The Baltimore Orioles cruised to a 5-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins. Gunnar Henderson led the Orioles' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, including 2 RBIs. Brandon Young earned the win, allowing just 1 run in 6 innings.

**Reds Edge Out White Sox 5-4**

The Cincinnati Reds outlasted the Chicago White Sox, taking the final score 5-4. Eugenio Suárez delivered a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including an RBI. Sean Burke was stellar on the mound, striking out 8 in 7 innings.

**Cardinals Blank Phillies 2-0**

The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, taking the final score 2-0. Everson Pereira provided the offense with a 1-hit, 1-home run performance, including an RBI. Cristopher Sánchez earned the win, allowing just 0 runs in 6 innings.

**Angels Outlast Rangers 3-2**

The Los Angeles Angels edged out the Texas Rangers, taking the final score 3-2. Joc Pederson delivered a 1-hit, 1-home run performance, including an RBI. Ryan Johnson was solid on the mound, striking out 5 in 4.1 innings.

**Rockies Take Down Diamondbacks 2-3**

The Colorado Rockies outlasted the Arizona Diamondbacks, taking the final score 3-2. Kyle Karros delivered a 1-hit, 1-home run performance, including 2 RBIs. Tomoyuki Sugano earned the win, allowing just 2 runs in 6 innings.

**Rays Crush Athletics 12-4**

The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Oakland Athletics, taking the final score 12-4. Taylor Walls led the Rays' offense with a 2-hit, 2-home run performance, including 3 RBIs. Brady Basso was solid on the mound, striking out 2 in 2 innings.

**Padres Rout Brewers 11-2**

The San Diego Padres cruised to an 11-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers. Luis Rengifo delivered a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including 4 RBIs. Walker Buehler was nearly unhittable on the mound, striking out 5 in 6 innings.

**Giants Shut Down Astros 4-1**

The San Francisco Giants dominated the Houston Astros, taking the final score 4-1. Bryce Eldridge delivered a 1-hit, 1-home run performance, including an RBI. Carson Whisenhunt earned the win, allowing just 1 run in 6 innings.
